pv33:1.1: Kūṭāgāre ca pāsāde pallaṅke goṇakatthate pañcaṅgikena turiyena ramasi suppavādite. || ||
pv33:2.1: Tato ratyā vyavasāne suriyuggamanaṃ pati apaviddho susānasmiṃ bahudukkhaṃ nigacchasi. || ||
pv33:3.1: Kin nu kāyena vācāya manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ kissa kammavipākena idaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchasī ti. || ||
pv33:4.1: Ahaṃ Rājagahe ramme ramaṇīye Giribbaje migaluddo pure āsiṃ luddo c' āsiṃ asaññato. || ||
pv33:5.1: Tassa me sahāyo suhadayo saddho āsi upāsako tassa kulūpago bhikkhu āsi Gotamasāvako, so pi maṃ anukampanto nivāresi punappunaṃ: || ||
pv33:6.1: Mākāsi pāpakaṃ kammaṃ mā tāta duggatiṃ agā sace icchasi pecca sukhaṃ virama pāṇavadhā asaṃyamā. || ||
pv33:7.1: Tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā sukhakāmassa hitānukampino nākāsiṃ sakalānusāsaniṃ cirapāpābhirato abuddhimā. || ||
pv33:8.1: So maṃ puna bhūrisumedhaso anukampāya saṃyame nivesayi sace divā hanasi pāṇino atha te rattiṃ bhavatu saṃyamo. || ||
pv33:9.1: Svāhaṃ divā hanitva pāṇino virato rattim ahosi saññato rattāhaṃ paricāremi divā khajjāmi duggato. || ||
pv33:10.1: Tassa kammassa kusalassa anubhomi rattiṃ amānusiṃ divā paṭihatā va kukkurā upadhāvanti samantā khādituṃ. || ||
pv33:11.1: Ye ca te satatānuyogino dhuvaṃ payuttā sugatassa sāsane maññāmi te amatam eva kevalaṃ adhigacchanti padaṃ asaṅkhatan ti. || ||
